Xannie Techs today

Xannie Techs already builds the apps businesses run on.

Xannie Techs is a Johannesburg technology company building digital solutions for startups, SMEs and enterprises.1 It offers web development, mobile apps for iOS and Android, cloud solutions, UI and UX design, IT consulting, VoIP and networking, and digital marketing. Its showcased work runs from property and service marketplaces to e-commerce, events and financial services sites.1 Each of those clients has customers and staff who travel.

7services, from apps to VoIP1
8client projects on show1
Joburga South African team1
iOS and Androidapps built in-house1
What is at stake

South Africans travel. Their data money goes to someone else.

South African residents made 667,890 departures in December 2025 alone.2 Each one needs data the moment they land. Today they buy a network travel bundle, such as 5GB for 7 days at R349, or a foreign eSIM app.3 None of that reaches Xannie Techs, which earns once when a site or app ships. Xannie Roam turns every app and site Xannie builds into a channel that earns on every trip, for years.

The packs

Four packs, matched to who your clients are.

The DSG travel eSIM range covers 150 or more countries, in small, medium and large packs.4 Prices are set with Xannie Techs in the CVP workshop. Pricing to be confirmed on the country and pack list.

AfricaSmall, medium, large

For cross-border business and family trips in SADC and across Africa. Grows SME accounts.

GlobalSmall, medium, large

150 or more countries, for holidays and long-haul work trips. Grows app sales.

TeamsPer trip, one bill

For SMEs sending staff abroad, managed in one console. Grows IT and VoIP contracts.

Welcome to SASmall, medium, large

For visitors hosted by Xannie's clients, online on landing. Grows booking-site work.

What a traveller gets

A traveller saves about R100 on a week of data abroad, and gets things no network can give.

A network travel bundle of 5GB for 7 days costs R349.3 A Xannie Roam trip pack is R249.23, the DSG Travel eSIM trip pack.4 That saves a traveller R99.77, if the pack carries 5GB for a week, which is set in the CVP workshop.

Data inside their own site

Customers of Xannie's clients buy travel data where they already shop or book.

Live the moment you land

No queue for a local SIM. The eSIM is installed with one scan before the flight.

Home number stays on

A dual eSIM, so bank codes still reach the South African number.

One bill for the team

Every travelling staff member on one business console.

The office line travels

Xannie VoIP numbers ring abroad over Roam data.

Safe on hotel wi-fi

Bitdefender for phones and a Personal Cyber Warranty as add-ons.

Perks are proposals. Xannie Techs decides the final list. Pack data allowance set in the CVP workshop. The Vodacom price is from January 2024 and current prices may differ.

Signature ideas

Three ideas only Xannie plus a travel eSIM can run.

Packs and prices are table stakes. These are the ideas that make Xannie Roam different. Each drives a core Xannie Techs line, and each is a proposal for Xannie to shape.

Roam DeskEvery site Xannie builds can sell travel data

A module Xannie drops into the sites and apps it builds. The client's customers buy travel data on the client's own site, and the client earns on every pack from Xannie's half of the margin. Drives web development sales, because a Xannie site now earns money for its owner. Only Xannie writes the code; a network cannot sit inside a client's website. Needs integration with the eSIM platform, confirmed in a technical session.

Roam for TeamsOne console for every business trip

An SME boss assigns packs, tracks use per trip and tops up mid-trip, on one bill. Xannie is already the IT, cloud and VoIP partner these SMEs call, so travel data joins the same account. Drives IT consulting and VoIP contracts. Needs the business console on the eSIM platform and team pricing set by Xannie.

Land ReadyYour clients' guests are online at OR Tambo

A host, venue or event organiser adds a Welcome to SA pack to the booking, and the guest lands online. Xannie builds the booking site, so the data rides on the booking. Drives booking-site builds and digital marketing work. Needs a Welcome to SA pack on the eSIM platform.
